lines.text: I look forward to the weekend!
Many learners say: I am looking forward on the weekend.
Better: I am looking forward to the weekend.
To! I am looking forward to the weekend.

native.tip: Im Deutschen sagen wir „sich freuen auf“. Im Englischen sagen Sie „look forward to“, nicht „look forward on“.

en.tip: German says “sich freuen auf.” English says “look forward to,” not “look forward on.”
en.caption: Say “look forward to”! Wrong: “I am looking forward on the weekend.” Right: “I am looking forward to the weekend.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
